evidence.r1: Light and dark: glass is confined to the top planner controls and the route-selection menu; the editorial sheet is solid.
evidence.r2: Light and dark route menus replace the route capsule, and the selected Cascade Pass row is a flat translucent fill.
evidence.r3: Light and dark: only route, weather and permit surfaces occupy the floating bar.
evidence.r4: Light and dark: the three top capsules and open route menu share one frosted material treatment.
evidence.r5: Light and dark: the planner uses frosted regular-looking glass, not a separate clear treatment.
evidence.r6: Reduced-transparency light: the purple switch below the introduction is a tinted secondary control, not the primary trip action.
evidence.r7: Light route menu: the surface visibly picks up the blue lake and pale sheet behind it instead of remaining a solid colour.
evidence.r8: Light and dark: top controls are capsules and the route menu has a consistent fixed corner radius.
evidence.r9: Light route menu: the selected mid-list pill has tighter end arcs than the large menu corner minus its narrow inset.
evidence.r10: Light and dark: route, weather and Permits use fully rounded capsule silhouettes.
evidence.r11: Light and dark: route data share one capsule, weather another, and permits a third.
evidence.r12: Light and dark: route and weather symbols belong to their text controls, with no independent icon button sharing those capsules.
evidence.r13: Light and dark: each planner control has one continuous glass silhouette rather than separate glass behind its icon and words.
evidence.r14: Light and dark: the planner capsules have deliberate, generous gaps and matching material.
evidence.r15: Light and dark full captures: no scrolled state or scroll-edge treatment beneath the top planner is visible.
evidence.r16: Light route menu: its lower portion extends over the flat pale editorial sheet.
evidence.r17: Light and dark resting views: headings and route details begin well below the floating planner.
evidence.r18: Light and dark: planner and menu text remain strongly dark-on-pale or pale-on-charcoal, including small distances.
evidence.r19: Reduced light: the planner remains readable, but no increased-contrast or reduced-motion state is supplied.
evidence.r20: Light and dark: the lake photograph reaches both window edges behind the floating controls.
evidence.r21: Light and dark full captures stop at the introduction, leaving clearance of the scrolling trail content unshown.
evidence.r22: Light and dark: the planner and route menu float directly on the scene without a separate backing strip.
evidence.r23: Light and dark closed/open route captures show endpoints only, not materialisation, morphing or pointer feedback.
evidence.r24: Light and dark: top planner labels and symbols are monochrome; the lake and editorial status marks carry colour.
evidence.r25: Light and dark: planner labels use neutral ink rather than the blue-green hues of the lake and forest.
